subject.title: wacli skill: add recipient allowlist and confirm-before-send enforcement

question: Should wacli outbound safety remain instruction-only, or should the WhatsApp plugin define an enforced recipient allowlist and redacted audit policy for wacli-style sends?
rationale: The requested behavior affects outbound WhatsApp authorization, persistent or workspace policy state, privacy-preserving audit records, bulk-send limits, and the boundary between model instructions and runtime/tool enforcement.

options.title: Define plugin-owned enforcement
options.body: Create a WhatsApp plugin/wacli safety contract for recipient allowlists, redacted audit records, and bulk-send limits before updating the skill text.

options.title: Harden skill instructions first
options.body: Tighten SKILL.md now with allowlist, confirmation, audit, and bulk-send guidance while tracking runtime enforcement separately.

options.title: Keep broad confirmation only
options.body: Leave wacli on the current recipient/message confirmation guidance and rely on general exec approvals and operator configuration.

recommendation.title: Define plugin-owned enforcement
recommendation.body: Create a WhatsApp plugin/wacli safety contract for recipient allowlists, redacted audit records, and bulk-send limits before updating the skill text.

likelyOwner.reason: The current wacli skill guidance and upstream wacli package history point primarily to steipete for the safety-policy choice.
